Zero. I haven't looked recently but the directions for posting feedback items says to make a feedback item per issue, and to not staple any list to the front door of vrchat. 

1a. Personally I feel like the age verification is great for avoiding kids, I've opted in to be able to avoid younger users, and this is not the same as what needs to be done about predators. I guess if under 18s could prove that they are under 18, and then visit age verified instances that are for them, that could work, but i have suspicions that this would be impractical.

1b. Your story isn't clear on who got banned, if it was temp or not. But if you have two friends Bob and Rob, if Bob reports Rob as being autistic, I could understand Bob getting banned, but if they banned Rob, you should definitely reach out to VRChat support, which I guarantee is not this feedback board.

2. VRChat is user generated content, creating content that is optimized for mobile is difficult. As a PCVR user it was my observation that the quest 2 has kinda sucked for vrchat ever since meta added hand tracking. I've tried vrchat on quest 3s, and it seems okay for the most part, but I think the quest users figure out what worlds don't really work that well, and avoid them. I'd like to see vrchat turn the screws a little bit more on limiting mobile content, but I think they're working on some optimization tools. Personally when I'm on quest I prefer seeing the imposters, and I basically only have one friends avatar actually turned on.

I've seen too many quest avatars that are merely material changes made to stupidly heavy PC avatars. 300k polygons across 50 meshes and 50 materials needs a top of the long PC to not lag out.

3a. You should be more clear on exactly what you're complaining about. Are you complaining about like an Ashley Madison ad in public? I guess that reference is a bit old. Or maybe you're telling me that I might be able to visit a world like popcorn palace and see some nudity in the posters?

3b. The current claim with popcorn palace is that the world doesn't contain links to anything, that a user has to provide a certain URL to access content in that world. I'm going to withhold my thoughts on this and VRChat's use of YouTube.

details:
General feedback I need yall to hear, 

1, I feel as if you do not priotise support and protection for kids and minors on this platform and what ID verification yall have is locked behind a paywall. I've met countless groomers and predators on the app over my 6 years and I've reported them aswell as  my friends did yet they had no account bans or anything done. But as soon as my a friend jokinly reported his friend for ''having autism'' the report wasn't even read or anything instead the friends account was banned without reason. 

2) optimisation, I run on quest 2 and I am aware support for that has probably ended but regardless quest 3 users will in no doubt in time suffer the same issues of memory and ram being clogged because avatars and worlds are under optimised. Please make this a requirement when publishing a avatar or at least let add more settings to disable features on the vrchat game.

 3) Why is vrchat dating apps and sexual worlds permitted onto a hangout social app for 13+ and it isn't a private instance thing since they're all over popcorn palace and other world promoting this stuff. Not to mention isn't pirating movies illegal in some cases how are popcorn palace and other movie worlds allowed to be around.
